B2.v: Scope: Oil-immersed three-phase distribution transformers up to 2,500 kVA and up to 33 kV (IS 1180 Part 1 range). Larger or higher-voltage units belong in the Power model.

B5.v: 1. Calculator, Section A: one column per configuration. Enter BOQ values; blanks take the default shown on Calculations section 0.

B6.v: 2. Calculator, Sections B and C: material master prices and design constants, editable on the same tab.

B7.v: 3. Enter a reference price (PR valuation or PO rate, ex-works) and set 'Calibration applied'. 'Own' solves the factor that makes the model equal that price; 'Model average' applies the mean of all 'Own' columns to an unpriced configuration.

B8.v: 4. Outputs: engineering cost, factor, calibrated price, weights, size and design checks. IEEMA: price at delivery.

B11.v: • v9's single model is split into three files: Power (oil), Distribution (oil), Dry-type (cast resin). Oil-immersed and dry-type are never blended.

B12.v: • Batch layout: five configurations side by side instead of one transformer per workbook.

B13.v: • Geometry: coil height = ratio × core diameter replaces v9's window-space-factor + fixed 3:1 window. At 400 kV that combination gave a 14.8 m tank and ~200 t of oil for a 315 MVA unit.

B14.v: • Single-phase units of a bank: two wound limbs, plus two half-section return limbs at large ratings; HV winding voltage = line ÷ √3 for star.

B15.v: • Accessories, tap changer, fittings, tests and labour % are priced by voltage class (Assumptions & Ref R.1), so a 400 kV station transformer carries 400 kV bushings and OLTC regardless of MVA.

B16.v: • v9 bug fixed: IEEMA!C62:I62 referenced an external workbook ([1]IEEMA); weights are now internal.

B19.v: Engineering first: weights from geometry, priced at Section B rates, plus voltage-class accessories and conversion. Then one factor = reference price ÷ engineering cost, applied to the total. The factor is a diagnostic, not a discount: it shows how far unverified rates, OEM premium and the reference price's own basis sit from the physics.

B20.v: No distribution transformer reference price was supplied, so the example configurations run uncalibrated (factor 1.00). Enter a PO rate in Section A and set 'Own PR/PO price' to calibrate.

B23.v: • Tank volume (oil models): no source data. Rectangular clearance envelope around the active part × shaping factor (Calculator C). Enter the GTP oil quantity in Section A when the OEM gives it; it then overrides the estimate.

B24.v: • Clearances, insulation ratios and all accessory / test rates in Assumptions & Ref are INDICATIVE. CRGO Rs 95/kg is carried from v9 and is UNVERIFIED; it is the largest single rate uncertainty.

B25.v: • Losses: power defaults from CBIP Annex 1.1 (extrapolated beyond 160 MVA / 220 kV and flagged); distribution from IS 1180 (Pt 1):2014; dry-type has no default table.
